name: Latest
description: Latest configures its own Sparkle feed with a pinned SUPublicEDKey and uses SPUUpdater to check and install updates for discovered Sparkle app bundles, reading each target bundle's SUFeedURL (with a DevMate fallback). Target-app key configuration and Sparkle runtime enforcement remain delegated and were not independently audited in this snapshot.
limitations: Newly retrieved default-branch snapshot, not the original study checkout; external target-app key material, Sparkle's dependency-level verifier, and historical release artifacts were not independently reverified.
